newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to limit pension funds in selloffs-minister.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to limit pension funds in selloffs-minister.

text.p: Brazil's National Privatization Council (CND) on Thursday limited pension fund participation in federal privatizations to a total 25 percent of the capital of a bidding consortium, Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said.

"The government has decided it makes no sense to have an exaggerated or disproportionate participation in privatizations of people who just provide finance," Kandir told reporters after a regular CND meeting.
Kandir said the 25 percent limit applied to private and public sector pension funds.
But he said it did not apply to sell-offs by Brazilian states.

The minister said the government would suggest to the states informally that they follow its example as the process of privatization would benefit fropm the entry of large operators into the management of those firms.
